Dots and Boxes

Dots and Boxes on a 5×5 dot grid — claim edges, complete boxes, and outsmart the greedy computer.

0
You
0
Computer
16
Boxes total

📖 How to use

  1. Pick “Vs computer” or “Two players” and press New game.
  2. Click any unclaimed edge between two dots to draw your line.
  3. Finish a box to score a point — and take another turn.
  4. Most boxes when all 16 are claimed wins.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Do I get another turn after completing a box?

Yes. Completing a box scores a point and gives you another turn immediately — chain reactions can swing the whole game.

How does the computer choose?

The computer first grabs any edge that completes a box for itself, then avoids handing you a free box when it can, and otherwise picks randomly.

Can it end in a draw?

There are 16 boxes. With an even count a draw is possible — and common against the computer.
